Intent: Add retryDelay with exponential backoff for gateway calls.
Head: 798c860669f1f29e793baa39883fab99d389b528
Diff:
diff --git a/client/retry.go b/client/retry.go
index ebde38d..2661ab0 100644
--- a/client/retry.go
+++ b/client/retry.go
@@ -1,4 +1,23 @@
 package client
 
+import "time"
+
 // MaxAttempts is the number of attempts before a request fails.
 const MaxAttempts = 5
+
+// retryDelay returns the delay before the given zero-based retry attempt.
+func retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {
+	// set the base delay to 100 milliseconds
+	delay := 100 * time.Millisecond
+	// loop over the attempts and double the delay each time
+	for i := 0; i < attempt; i++ {
+		delay *= 2
+	}
+	// The payment gateway closes idle connections after 6 seconds
+	// (https://example.com/gateway-limits), so the delay stays below that.
+	if delay > 5*time.Second {
+		delay = 5 * time.Second
+	}
+	// return the delay
+	return delay
+}
